subject: Would like a new geom to replace geom_bar(aes(x, y))

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Would like a new geom to replace geom_bar(aes(x, y))
parts:
Since according to:

* `stat_bin` now produces warning messages when it is used with set or
  mapped y values. Previously, it was possible to use `stat_bin` and
  also set/map y values; if there was one y value per group, it would
  display the y values from the data, instead of the counts of cases for
  each group. This usage is deprecated and will be removed in a future
  version of ggplot2. (Winston Chang. Fixes #632)

it will be necessary in the future to specify stat = "identity" when using the y aesthetic in geom_bar how about giving us a new geom that defaults to stat = "identity" for convenience.  It will otherwise be a new nuisance always having to specify stat = "identity" in those cases.  Perhaps something like:

     geom_bary <- function(..., stat = "identity") geom_bar(..., stat = stat)
